description: Create many tasks in a single List in one call (up to 100). Runs with bounded concurrency and returns a per-task success/error report, so a partial failure never loses the rest of the batch. Use to import or scaffold many tasks at once.

list_id.description: ID of the destination List for all created tasks.

tasks.description: Array of task definitions to create (1–100 per call).

assignees.description: User ids to assign the task to.

due_date.description: Due date (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

parent.description: Parent task id, to create this task as a subtask.

status.description: Status name (must exist in the List, e.g. 'to do', 'in progress').

tags.description: Tag names to apply (must already exist in the Space).

name: create_bulk_tasks
